tasks.label: Push website to GitHub
tasks.command: git init && git branch -M main && git add . && git commit -m "Initial website upload" && (git remote get-url origin >NUL 2>&1 && git remote set-url origin https://github.com/geetrendsmiley/odmvilleagency.git || git remote add origin https://github.com/geetrendsmiley/odmvilleagency.git) && git push -u origin main
